title: HIIT Circuit Card — three athletes, four stations
notes: Each athlete is a track and each station is a maxConcurrent 1 resource, so the rotation is expressed as cross-track compound triggers: an athlete starts a station when their own rest is done AND the athlete ahead of them has left it. The four round lines in the source give each of the twelve work steps a distinct span; the rest rule and the warm-up are stated once and shared by the steps that realise them.
